events.description: Vessel arrived at Mykolaiv pilot station.
NOR tendered to Kernel Trading. PSC inspection NOT yet completed.
Charterers protested NOR — vessel not ready in all respects, PSC clearance pending.
PSC inspection in progress. Loading not commenced pending outcome.
PSC clearance obtained. Two minor deficiencies corrected. No detention.
NOR retendered by Master. Accepted without further protest. Laytime dispute noted.
Oil loading commenced. All 4 tanks. Shore pumps running.
Pumping rate reduced — shore tank switchover. 30-min delay.
Pilot on board. Last line let go.

notes: DISPUTED LAYTIME. Owners (WIBON, original NOR 0730): 51.5h used, 32.5h despatch. Charterers (retendered NOR 1415): 44.75h used, 39.25h despatch. Difference 6.75h. Black Sea region, sunflower oil bulk.
